drafter.private_reasoning: We need to propose a specific purchase price while anchoring the negotiation below the client’s maximum authority. Suggesting $32,000,000 is prudent for an initial offer. Clarifying the indemnity provision to cap Seller's aggregate liability and limiting temporal scope (e.g., 18 months) is market-standard and friendly but still protective of the Buyer. We should also add a warranty that there are no undisclosed liabilities, and propose that closing prerequisites include receipt of key regulatory approvals, to reduce Buyer's risk. All changes will be clearly marked as tracked changes, for transparency.

We have inserted the specific purchase price for your review, clarified and limited the indemnity provision to reflect market norms, and addressed a few additional standard points to help streamline the process. Please let us know if you have any questions or would like to discuss any of these further.

receiver.message_back: Thank you for the draft. While we appreciate the clarity on the purchase price, our client considers the proposed USD 32,000,000 significantly below fair market value; we are instructed to seek an increased purchase price. We will also be seeking a longer claims period for indemnity and will provide redlines accordingly.

drafter.private_reasoning: Bellweather Croft LLP has pushed back on our proposed USD 32,000,000 purchase price, suggesting it's significantly below fair market value and seeks an increase, while also telegraphing a longer indemnity claims period. Our confidential maximum is USD 36,000,000, so we have a negotiation band of USD 32-36M. To show good faith and momentum, we can counter at USD 34,000,000 (still below our maximum) and await their response, which leaves us room to make a further (final) movement if strictly necessary. As they will be sending indemnity period redlines, we do not unilaterally propose changes to this yet. Instead, we reiterate our position emphasizing commercial certainty and alignment with market, inviting their specific comments.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you for your prompt note and the clarification of your client's position on the purchase price. We have discussed your feedback internally and are prepared, in the interests of progressing matters constructively, to increase the Purchase Price to thirty-four million US dollars (USD 34,000,000), payable at Closing as previously set out. We consider this to be a strong and market-aligned proposal. With respect to the indemnity claims period, we look forward to reviewing your proposed language and rationale and remain open to discussion, mindful of our client's need for commercial certainty. Please see the attached updated draft.
